context.transcript:
Thanks for listening to Weekend Science.
I'm your host, Paul Farouk.
My guest today is Dr. Helen Yu.
She's part of a team working on the Z9 telescope, which is used to look at distant stars.
Dr. Yu, can you tell us more about the project?
Sure.
The Z9 telescope is located in one of the driest deserts on Earth.
We chose that spot so there'd be very little interference from rain or clouds, so you get a very clear image.
And has your team made any interesting discoveries?
It has.
Tomorrow I'll be presenting our findings at a research conference in Sydney, and I can share some of the highlights with you now.
context.transcript_translation:
感谢收听《周末科学》。
我是主持人 Paul Farouk。
我今天的嘉宾是 Helen Yu 博士。
她是一个致力于 Z9 望远镜项目的团队成员，该望远镜用于观测遥远的恒星。
Yu 博士，您能告诉我们更多关于这个项目吗？
当然可以。
Z9 望远镜位于地球上最干燥的沙漠之一。
我们选择那个地点是为了最大限度地减少雨水或云层造成的干扰，这样才能获得非常清晰的图像。
您的团队有没有做出任何有趣的发现？
有。
明天我将在悉尼的一个研究会议上展示我们的研究结果，我现在可以和您分享一些亮点。
